choosing-yarn-for-crochet.heading: Compare yarn choices in real projects
choosing-yarn-for-crochet.introduction: Use each pattern’s own materials list alongside the guide. These projects show how yarn texture and thickness can differ; they are not interchangeable yarn recommendations.

projects.reason: Compare the bunny’s plush chenille requirements with the guide’s advice on texture and stitch visibility.
Look at the kitten’s fine cotton thread and 1.5 mm hook before considering a yarn substitution.
Check the cotton yarn and different hook sizes listed for the cat, hat, and pumpkin pieces.

crochet-loops-front-back.heading: See front and back loops in a pattern
crochet-loops-front-back.introduction: These projects use loop-specific instructions. Read the linked component and follow that pattern’s stitch counts; the guide explains loop placement rather than replacing the instructions.

projects.reason: Luna’s sleeves and body use BLO, while her cuffs, skirt, and hat brim use FLO.
The kitten pattern introduces BLO and FLO in its abbreviation list and uses loop-specific shaping.
See how the pumpkin’s BLO stitches mark its shaping lines across repeated rounds.

how-to-read-crochet-patterns.heading: Read the notation in a real pattern
how-to-read-crochet-patterns.introduction: Explore how the supplied patterns present repeats, color changes, rows, and rounds. These are examples to read alongside the guide; check each project’s own materials and skill information before starting.

projects.reason: See grouped repeat rounds and numbered steps in the bunny’s leg instructions.
Use the abbreviation table to follow the kitten’s color labels and repeat notation.
Compare rounds in the cat pieces with the turned rows used for Luna’s cloak.
